cause: The node panel header still rendered a standalone Close button beside Actions even though the workspace tab strip already owned node-tab closing. The first focused test run also exposed one stale fixture assertion using the wrong node tab label; both the UI and assertion were corrected before final verification.

evidence.ref: Focused Vitest: 4 files, 90 tests passed. Full Vitest: 188 files, 1629 tests passed. Typecheck and git diff --check passed. Browser acceptance verified docked and floating node panels: Actions precedes the shared Float/Pin/Collapse controls, no standalone Close exists, the tab strip retains Close Derived interaction tab, and the panel was restored to docked state.

impact: The initial focused test run failed on stale test expectations only; no runtime failure remained. The final UI has one clear node-tab close entry and consistent panel-window controls.
lesson: When moving a close affordance from panel chrome to a tab strip, test both the exact tab label and the absence of an exact standalone Close button; verify docked and floating portals separately.
